2. Facts, in brief, are that the pre-emptor-appellant-Opposite Party no.1 filed preemption Miscellaneous case no. 40 of 1999 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (n short, the Act) before the learned Assistant Judge, Baraigram, Natore Sadar, Natore  against the pre-emptor petitioner and Opposite Party no. 2-5 contending inter-alia that while pre-emptee no.2 was owning and possessing the suit land after purchasing the same from the original owner one Fajlur Rahman by way of registered deed dated 24.06.97, the pre-emptor purchased 161/2 decimals of land out of 2.00 acres of land of the schedule jote, vide registered sale deed dated 01.09.1997 and was enjoying possession thereof in ejmali with pre-emptor no.2. That thereafter the pre-emptor no.2 transferred 66 decimals of land situated at north west side of 1.00 acre land in the schedule jote to pre-emptee no.1 vide registered sale deed dated 10.12.1998 without notice to the pre-emptor. That the pre-emptor came to know about the said sale after obtaining the certified copy of the deed complained of. That the pre-emptor is a co-sharer by purchase and is the adjacent land owner whereas the pre-emptor no.1 is a stranger. That the pre-emptor no.2 before saling the said 66 decimals of land to the pre-emptor no. 1 transferred 33 decimals of land to his wife Khurshida and nephew Babul vide registered sale deed dated 07.12.1998, as a result the pre-emptor no.1 will get value of 11/2 Bigha and pre-emptor will get return value of 161/2 decimals land. 

 particularly the examination in chief as well as the cross examination of P.W. 1 the pre-emptor and also the application filed by the said pre-emptor under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act wherefrom it appears that as to the question of limitation he stated that he came to know about the said impugned transfer in favour of the pre-emptee no. 2 by the pre-emptee no.1 when he obtained the certified copy of the Said deed on 17.6.1999 which has been exhibited as exhibit-1. In support of the same, while recording his deposition particularly in chief he stated that he could not remember when he came to know about the said impugned transfer upon procuring the certified copy of the said deed. However, in his cross he stated আমি সাইদুরের দলিল হবার তিন মাস পর সেই বিষয়ে জানতে পারি। 

 10. Considering the statements of the pre-emptor particularly the words “ তিন মাস পর”  the appellate court has given the analogy of the fact that the knowledge of transfer of pre-emptor was "after" three months of the execution of the deed i.e. in between second week of the month of March and the second week of April, 1999 and that being so since the pre-emptor case has been filed within the required period of four months from the said date of knowledge i.e. on 26.7.1999 the pre-emption case is not barred by law. The appellate court being the last court of fact and its finding as to limitation having not been tamted by any misreading of non-consideration of material evidence no interference is called for by this court exercising revisional jurisdiction under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure. In that view of the matter I am of the opinion that learned Joint District Judge, 1" Court, Natore has committed on illegality in allowing the Miscellaneous Appeal no. 10 of 2002 upon reversing the judgment and order dated 1.1.2002 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Baraigram, Natore Sadar, Natore.
